text:
jamie_docs: Quick PR opened to tighten up the Optimize toolkit migration doc + add JS/TS snippets and a cURL example. Also fixing two broken links that slipped into the quickstart. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4120 

ci-bot: PR #4120 opened by jamie_docs • labels: docs,optkit,needs-review

sam_eng: scanning now. are we changing any runtime behavior or just docs?

jamie_docs: docs-only. added a bold callout: "no runtime changes". The main edits: 1) JS/TS SDK snippets parity with Python examples, 2) migration checklist, 3) alias table for legacy quant_profile names, 4) replace two stale Console links.

nina_opt: thanks. please include a short note about prefetch + streaming: prefetch helps batch throughput but can increase first-token latency for streaming/interactive flows. recommend `prefetch_kv: false` for short-turns.

jamie_docs: added heuristics and a one-line rule: "Disable KV prefetch for short-turn dialog or streaming (typical seq < 48) to keep first-token p50 low." Also added microbenchmark lines for reviewers.

sam_eng: nice. can you add a JS snippet that demonstrates streaming + the prefetch toggle? some of our customers use node and that was missing.

jamie_docs: done. JS streaming example (in doc):
```js
import { OptimizeClient } from '@redwood/inference';
const c = new OptimizeClient();
// streaming, low-latency
c.configure({ streaming: true, batchSize: 1, prefetch_kv: false, quant_profile: 'q8_aliased' });
for await (const chunk of c.streamGenerate('Tell me a short poem')) {
  process.stdout.write(chunk.text);
}
```

oliver_pm: product nit: the quickstart still links to the old Console overview. please point Console links to /console/telemetry and note that rollouts respect alias mapping. left an inline comment.

jamie_docs: fixed both Console links to /console/telemetry and added the rollout note. rebased and pushed.

deploy-bot: staging preview created for refs/heads/docs/pr-4120 • https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/optkit/migration

ci-bot: CI: docs-lint PASS, link-check FAIL (2 broken links) — see inline comments

jamie_docs: the link-check failures were internal anchor mismatches. fixed anchors and one anchor text that the link-check bot flagged. pushed again.

ci-bot: CI: link-check PASS • other checks PASS

nina_opt: small content nit: the JS snippet uses `batchSize` vs `batch_size` right now to match the JS SDK surface — can we add a short note saying field names differ slightly across SDKs and link to the SDK reference?

jamie_docs: added a short note and link to the SDK reference section (anchor: /sdk/js#configure). Also added TypeScript example with types to make it clear for TS users.

sam_eng: can we include a cURL snippet for folks prototyping without the SDK? sometimes helpful for ops people.

jamie_docs: added cURL example showing how to set profile headers and body:```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/optimize/generate 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"model":"gpt-4x","profile":"low-latency","quant_profile":"q8_aliased","input":"Summarize: ..."}'
```

oliver_pm: small request: add one-line release-note entry and ping #support after merge so they can watch for any migration questions.

jamie_docs: will do. also added a short test checklist for QA: 1) run smoke tests with seq=16 and seq=256, 2) validate Console link, 3) verify JS streaming snippet runs in node 18.

sam_eng: pasted quick smoke numbers from local runs for reviewer reference:
```
[smoke] low-latency seq=16 p50=30ms tokens/s=150
[smoke] throughput seq=256 p50=118ms tokens/s=520
```

nina_opt: LGTM from opt side. added an internal note to monitor telemetry for a day for prefetch-related regressions.

sam_eng: LGTM from eng. tiny nit: prefer using `quant_profile: q8_legacy` in examples vs `q8_aliased` to keep wording intuitive.

jamie_docs: switched examples to `q8_legacy` and left an alias table showing both legacy -> aliased mapping. rebased and pushed.

ci-bot: CI: all checks green

jamie_docs: merging. will add a 1-line release-note and ping #support now. :tada:
